item.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
item.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

item.title: Union electricians welcome data center boom
item.description: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

item.title: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
item.description: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

item.title: The IRS slashed its staff. One result? More taxes going uncollected
